Once the experts corrected those, Astra’s solutions were confirmed correct, including examples such as the black‑string Page time and a full‑electron atomic solver.

One of the 50 questions stumped every model: given a noisy curve, infer the autonomous differential equation that generated it. This inverse problem is information‑asymmetric and non‑unique, requiring physical intuition. The authors note that when AI generates its own problems it often gets bogged down in tedious algebra and lacks the human “taste” – it can compute but cannot judge which solution path is worthwhile.

Earlier, a MIT study evaluated 254 recent theoretical papers by testing models from o1 to GPT‑5.5 in offline mode. The agreement rate rose from 2.8% for o1 to 34.6% for GPT‑5.5, an average increase of 22 percentage points per year over 16 months. The researchers caution that this is a longitudinal comparison of models within the same family and does not imply AI surpasses human scientists; answers still need expert validation.

The significance of TheoPhysEval lies in reshaping research labor: derivations and numerical calculations once assigned to PhD students for practice are now being handled by agents at roughly $2 per problem. Human scientists’ core value shifts forward—to define problems, design verification, and assess AI output reasonableness. The authors even suggest such “hand‑cranking” tasks are no longer suitable as introductory graduate exercises. In the short term AI acts as an “ tireless co‑author”; to truly take over physics, it still lacks the final inverse‑problem capability and a sense of artistic judgment.

items.title: 美歐科技摩擦升溫！歐盟擬留頻譜給本土業者　美大使警告「毀滅性」報復
items.title_en: US‑EU Tech Tensions Heat Up: EU Plans to Reserve Spectrum for Domestic Firms, US Ambassador Warns of ‘Devastating’ Retaliation
paras: 美歐科技監管爭議再擴大，美國駐歐盟大使Andrew Puzder最新警告，若歐盟推進限制美國企業取得部分歐洲衛星通訊頻譜的方案，美國恐對歐洲企業採取「毀滅性」報復。
Puzder向《金融時報》表示，歐企高度依賴美國市場，「一旦發生，對這些企業將非常具毀滅性」。
導火線是歐盟執委會今年提出的衛星直連手機頻譜分配方案。該方案擬把部分可讓智慧手機直接連網的頻段優先保留給歐洲企業，非歐洲業者能取得的頻率空間遭壓縮，受影響者包括SpaceX星鏈。
此前，SpaceX批評相關設計恐致歐洲手機直連衛星服務難以落地，甚至波及烏克蘭緊急通訊，星鏈自俄烏戰爭以來是烏方軍民通信骨幹。
歐執會則強調，提案目的是激勵歐盟供應商進入市場、實現供應多元，同時仍向非歐盟業者開放其他頻段，更大背景是歐洲降低對美技術依賴。除頻譜外，歐執會也推《雲端與AI發展法案》，對敏感雲端服務加主權要求，並扶持歐洲本土科技替代方案。
Puzder表示，美國理解歐洲保護政府敏感資訊的需求，但反對以立法削弱美企競爭力，並稱「不能靠壓低美國企業來抬高歐洲企業，美國科技產品可靠、值得信賴」。
他並諷刺，歐洲監管扶植是「整齊劃一的平庸」，並質疑《數位市場法》對美企開罰是否真為競爭，抑或為歐洲財政創收。
美歐這場爭議已不止星鏈准入，美方將頻譜、雲端主權、AI監管與數位罰款一併列為跨大西洋摩擦點，歐方則視為技術主權與關鍵基礎設施自主的必要佈局。
Puzder指出，美歐合作比對抗更容易贏下AI與量子競賽，但華府釋出明確信號，也就是若歐盟以「歐洲優先」排除美企，華府不排除用市場准入反制。
目前，歐盟提案仍需要會員國與歐洲議會磋商，未進入正式生效，後續是否觸發美國實質報復，取決於最終頻譜比例、星鏈豁免空間，以及雲端法案談判能否止血。
paras_en: US‑EU technology regulatory disputes have escalated further, with US Ambassador to the EU Andrew Puzder warning that if the EU pushes ahead with a plan to restrict US companies from accessing certain European satellite‑communication spectrum, the United States could take "devastating" retaliatory measures against European firms.
Puzder told the Financial Times that European companies are heavily dependent on the US market and that any such move would be extremely destructive for them.

The flashpoint is the European Commission’s proposal this year to allocate satellite‑direct‑to‑phone spectrum. The plan would prioritize certain bands that allow smartphones to connect directly to satellites for European companies, squeezing the frequency space available to non‑European operators, including SpaceX’s Starlink.

Previously, SpaceX criticized the design, saying it could make direct‑to‑satellite phone services in Europe difficult to implement and even affect Ukraine’s emergency communications; Starlink has been a communications backbone for Ukrainian military and civilians since the Russia‑Ukraine war began.

The Commission stresses that the proposal aims to spur EU suppliers into the market and achieve supply diversification while still leaving other bands open to non‑EU operators; the broader goal is to reduce Europe’s reliance on US technology. In addition to spectrum, the Commission is advancing a Cloud and AI Development Act that imposes sovereign requirements on sensitive cloud services and supports home‑grown European tech alternatives.

Puzder said the United States understands Europe’s need to protect government‑sensitive information but opposes legislation that would weaken the competitiveness of US firms, adding that “you can’t boost European companies by pushing down American ones; US tech products are reliable and trustworthy.”

He mocked European regulatory support as “uniform mediocrity” and questioned whether fines under the Digital Markets Act against US firms truly promote competition or simply serve as a revenue source for European budgets.

The US‑EU dispute now goes beyond Starlink access; Washington is bundling spectrum, cloud sovereignty, AI regulation and digital fines as trans‑Atlantic friction points, while Europe sees them as necessary steps for technological sovereignty and control over critical infrastructure.

Puzder noted that US‑EU cooperation would win the AI and quantum races more easily than confrontation, but Washington has sent a clear signal that if the EU adopts a “Europe‑first” stance that excludes US firms, the US will not rule out market‑access retaliation.

The EU proposal still requires negotiation with member states and the European Parliament and has not become law; whether it will trigger concrete US retaliation will depend on the final spectrum allocation, any Starlink exemptions, and whether cloud legislation negotiations can halt the escalation.

items.title: 黃仁勳最擔心的發生了！輝達中國AI晶片市佔率降至34%　華為28%居次、阿里平頭哥第三
items.title_en: Nvidia's Biggest Fear Has Come True! Nvidia's AI Chip Share in China Drops to 34%, Huawei at 28% Second, Alibaba's Pingtouge Third
paras: IDC最新研報指出，今年上半年中國資料中心AI晶片市場格局顯著變化，輝達以34%市占率居首，出貨量67.8萬顆，大幅年減44%，華為昇腾出貨57.2萬顆，市占率28%，兩者差距縮小至6個百分點。
輝達下滑主因美國出口管制收緊，Blackwell架構晶片無法進入中國，獲准的H200收入佔比不足1%。黃仁勳多次批評稱，500億美元中國市場正被迫讓給華為。
中國國產替代浪潮惠及整體產業鏈。除華為外，阿里平頭哥以7%份額位居第三，寒武紀、崑崙芯、海光資訊分別佔5%、4%和3%。IDC追蹤的11家中國晶片廠商中，9家今年上半年出貨量較一年前走增。
顯著變化是非GPU加速器出貨達101.6萬顆，年增近80%，首次超越GPU的99.1萬顆。華為、平頭哥、崑崙芯與寒武紀合計佔非GPU市場95%，主要用於政府機構、互聯網公司及電信商。
IDC指出，競爭焦點正從單顆晶片性能轉向系統整體能力。根據摩根士丹利預測，中國AI晶片自給率將從2025年35%升至2026年45%，2027年有望達68%。
paras_en: IDC's latest research report shows that the Chinese data‑center AI chip market saw a marked shift in the first half of this year. Nvidia remains on top with a 34% market share and shipments of 678,000 units, but that represents a steep 44% year‑over‑year decline. Huawei’s Ascend shipped 572,000 units, holding a 28% share, narrowing the gap between the two to just six percentage points.

The drop for Nvidia is mainly due to tighter U.S. export controls, which block the Blackwell‑architecture chips from entering China. The approved H200 accounts for less than 1% of revenue. CEO Jensen Huang has repeatedly warned that the $50 billion Chinese market is being forced to cede ground to Huawei.

The wave of domestic substitution is benefiting the broader supply chain. Beyond Huawei, Alibaba’s Pingtouge ranks third with a 7% share, while Cambricon, Kunlun Chip and Hai Guang Information hold 5%, 4% and 3% respectively. Among the 11 Chinese chip makers tracked by IDC, nine saw higher shipments in the first half of the year than a year earlier.

A striking change is the surge in non‑GPU accelerator shipments, which reached 1.016 million units—a near 80% year‑over‑year increase—and for the first time overtook GPU shipments, which stood at 991,000 units. Huawei, Pingtouge, Kunlun Chip and Cambricon together account for 95% of the non‑GPU market, primarily serving government agencies, internet firms and telecom operators.

IDC notes that the competitive focus is shifting from single‑chip performance to overall system capability. Morgan Stanley forecasts that China’s AI‑chip self‑sufficiency will rise from 35% in 2025 to 45% in 2026, and could reach 68% by 2027.

items.title: 蘋果晶片布局曝光：跳過高階M6直接押注M7　OLED MacBook Pro先沿用M5
items.title_en: Apple Chip Roadmap Revealed: Skipping High-End M6 to Bet Directly on M7, OLED MacBook Pro Will First Use M5
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，蘋果將只推出標準版M6，不再開發M6 Pro、M6 Max與M6 Ultra，研發資源轉向鎖定AI運算的M7系列。
《MacRumors》引述知名科技記者古爾曼(Mark Gurman)最新播客內容報導，M6標準版已率先用於新Mac mini，後續預計延伸至iMac與入門款14吋MacBook Pro，但高階Mac的晶片路線將從M5 Pro、M5 Max直接跳到M7世代，這也意味即將登場的OLED版MacBook Pro，螢幕與機身改款會先走，晶片卻不會同步跨代。
古爾曼指出，高階機型仍搭載今年3月發表的M5 Pro與M5 Max，換OLED螢幕當下不會有M6 Pro/Max，也更不會有M7，而搭載標準版M7的新入門MacBook Pro預計2027年推出，高階觸控OLED MacBook Pro要到2027年底才升上M7 Pro與M7 Max；旗艦級M7 Ultra則排到2028上半年。
由於Ultra晶片延後，Gurman認為2027年推出新款Mac Studio的可能性不高，桌機高階更新節奏也會跟著往後挪。
業界人士解讀，蘋果罕見「砍掉單代高階線」，主因是把神經引擎、記憶體頻寬與端側AI負載擺在更前面；M7被視為AI導向的一代，而非單純CPU/GPU常規迭代。對消費者來說，若等OLED螢幕改款可先買M5機型，若等M7 Pro/Max效能跨度則得排到2027年底。
paras_en: Foreign media reports that Apple will only launch a standard‑edition M6 and will not develop M6 Pro, M6 Max or M6 Ultra, shifting R&D resources toward the AI‑focused M7 series.

MacRumors, citing well‑known tech reporter Mark Gurman’s latest podcast, says the standard M6 has already been used in the new Mac mini and is expected to expand to the iMac and the entry‑level 14‑inch MacBook Pro, while the high‑end Mac chip line will jump from M5 Pro and M5 Max straight to the M7 generation, meaning the upcoming OLED MacBook Pro will get a screen and chassis refresh first, but its chip will not move up a generation at the same time.

Gurman notes that high‑end models will still carry the M5 Pro and M5 Max introduced in March, and when the OLED screen arrives there will be no M6 Pro/Max and certainly no M7; a standard‑edition M7‑powered entry‑level MacBook Pro is expected in 2027, while the high‑end touch‑OLED MacBook Pro won’t get M7 Pro and M7 Max until the end of 2027, and the flagship M7 Ultra is slated for the first half of 2028.
Because the Ultra chip is delayed, Gurman believes the likelihood of a new Mac Studio launching in 2027 is low, and the refresh cadence for high‑end desktop machines will also be pushed back.

Industry analysts interpret Apple’s rare decision to “cut the single‑generation high‑end line” as a move to prioritize the neural engine, memory bandwidth and edge‑AI workloads; M7 is seen as an AI‑oriented generation rather than a simple CPU/GPU iteration. For consumers, if you’re waiting for the OLED screen upgrade you can buy an M5 model now, but if you want the performance jump of M7 Pro/Max you’ll have to wait until the end of 2027.

items.title: 信貸市場重估算力租賃模式！CoreWeave股債雙殺成AI基建「暴風眼」 信用裂痕愈燒愈大？
items.title_en: Credit Market Reassesses Compute Leasing Model! CoreWeave’s Stock‑Bond Double‑Hit Makes AI Infrastructure a “Eye of the Storm” as Credit Cracks Widen
paras: 上周，AI基礎設施投資的正面敘事在信貸市場被撕開裂口，輝達重要客戶、新雲算力服務商CoreWeave遭遇股債雙殺，五年期信用違約交換(CDS)利差一度擴至1194.5基點，部分債券殖利率衝上15%至16%，進入困境債定價區間。市場人士解讀，這是以短期高利債支撐長周期重資產的AI基建模式，首次被信用市場強制重定價。
CoreWeave股價上週回撤逾25%，但其2031年到期債券價格跌至面值78至80美分，對應收益率約15.6%至16.2%；五年期CDS隱含違約機率超60%。債券投資人已不交易「AI需求有沒有」，而是交易「現金流能否涵蓋利息」。馬斯克看到債券殖利率數據後只回覆「Yikes」。
CoreWeave今年第二季營收25.75億美元，調整後EBITDA利潤率近59%，真正壓力在經營現金流與資本開支的裂口，Q2經營現金流僅約6.79億美元，淨利息支出6.4億美元，資本開支逾90億美元，自由現金流負57億美元。全年資本開支指引350億至390億美元，約為收入三倍；債務規模達355億美元，若計租賃義務更高。
伯恩斯坦(Bernstein)指出，CoreWeave為「資本極度密集、無獨立造血引擎」企業，客戶合約平均約三年，債務再融資窗口更長，資產端久期短於負債端，利率一上抬，利息即侵蝕利潤。
CoreWeave是高收益AI資料中心債最大單一租戶，涉及7檔、141億美元債務、1512兆瓦算力，佔市場發行量約31%。當最大租戶以困境收益率交易，Applied Digital、Core Scientific等邊緣發行人都被要求更高利差。
CoreWeave類要求利差約400基點，谷歌背書資產約195基點，亞馬遜租賃債約150基點，信用市場將風險下限整組上移。
供給面亦轉不利。2026年全球AI相關債務發行規模估近5700億美元，新債需加抵押與保護條款，融資成本抬升。
影響亦傳導至半導體與資本開支預戴爾上週跌逾20%，費城半導體指數連跌，SK海力士、三星等承壓。高盛警告，融資成本若持續偏高，半導體供應鏈2027至2028年可能出現訂單真空。
德意志銀行則樂觀強調，AI算力供不應求，黃仁勳亦稱CoreWeave無需救助，悲觀者如伯恩斯坦指出，積壓訂單壓不住利息與再融資溢價，「股權經濟學」脆弱。
高盛合伙人Mark Wilson指出，CoreWeave等類垃圾債跌勢未止以前，AI股反彈只是倉位修復。
CoreWeave事件也凸顯市場已認知AI算力需求真實性不再單獨撐估值，市場同時看自由現金流拐點與再融資窗口。擁有投資級評級的超大规模雲廠可續建，而靠舉債買晶片租算力的新雲模式，被迫轉向現金流驗證融資。
paras_en: Last week, the positive narrative around AI infrastructure investment was ripped open in the credit market when Nvidia’s key customer and new cloud‑compute provider CoreWeave suffered a stock‑bond double‑hit. The five‑year credit default swap (CDS) spread briefly widened to 1,194.5 basis points and some bond yields surged to 15‑16%, pushing them into distressed‑debt pricing territory. Market participants interpret this as the first time the credit market has forced a repricing of the AI infrastructure model that relies on short‑term high‑interest debt to fund long‑cycle, capital‑intensive assets.

CoreWeave’s share price fell more than 25% last week, while its 2031‑maturing bonds slid to 78‑80 cents on the dollar, implying yields of roughly 15.6%‑16.2%; the five‑year CDS implied a default probability of over 60%. Bond investors are no longer betting on whether “AI demand exists” but on whether cash flow can cover interest. After seeing the bond‑yield data, Elon Musk’s only reply was “Yikes.”

In Q2 this year CoreWeave generated $2.575 billion in revenue and an adjusted EBITDA margin of nearly 59%. The real pressure lies in the gap between operating cash flow and capital spending: Q2 operating cash flow was only about $679 million, net interest expense $640 million, and capex topped $9 billion, leaving free cash flow negative $5.7 billion. The full‑year capex guide is $35‑$39 billion, roughly three times revenue, and total debt stands at $35.5 billion, even higher when lease obligations are included.

Bernstein notes that CoreWeave is a “extremely capital‑intensive business with no independent cash‑generation engine.” Customer contracts average about three years, refinancing windows are longer, and the asset side’s duration is shorter than the liability side, so any rise in rates immediately erodes profit through higher interest costs.

CoreWeave is the largest single tenant in the high‑yield AI data‑center bond market, accounting for seven issues, $14.1 billion of debt and 1,512 MW of compute capacity—about 31% of the market issuance. When its biggest tenant trades at distressed yields, edge issuers such as Applied Digital and Core Scientific are forced to offer wider spreads.

CoreWeave‑type deals command spreads of roughly 400 basis points; Google‑backed assets trade around 195 basis points, and Amazon‑sponsored lease debt about 150 basis points, pushing the risk floor for the whole credit market upward.

Supply‑side conditions are also turning adverse. Global AI‑related debt issuance in 2026 is projected to approach $570 billion, with new issues requiring additional collateral and protective covenants, driving up financing costs.

The fallout is spilling over to semiconductors and capex forecasts. Dell fell more than 20% last week, the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index slipped, and companies like SK Hynix and Samsung are under pressure. Goldman Sachs warns that if financing costs stay elevated, the semiconductor supply chain could face an order vacuum in 2027‑2028.

Deutsche Bank remains upbeat, emphasizing that AI compute power is in short supply, and Nvidia’s Jensen Huang says CoreWeave doesn’t need a rescue. Pessimists such as Bernstein argue that a backlog of orders cannot offset rising interest and refinancing premiums, making the “equity economics” fragile.
Goldman partner Mark Wilson says that until the slide in junk bonds like CoreWeave’s fully stops, the rebound in AI stocks is merely a position‑rebalancing play.

The CoreWeave episode highlights that the market now recognizes AI compute demand alone can no longer sustain valuations; investors are also watching free‑cash‑flow turning points and refinancing windows. Investment‑grade, ultra‑large cloud operators can keep building, but the new cloud model that borrows to buy chips and lease compute is being forced to prove its cash‑flow viability before financing can continue.

items.title: 方舟伍德拒絕「賣出南韓」 稱外資拋售主因是程式交易
items.title_en: Ark Wood Rejects "Sell South Korea" Claim, Says Foreign Selling Driven by Algorithmic Trading
paras: 南韓股市近期因外資賣壓顯著走低，半導體類股遭遇大幅修正。對此，方舟投資(Ark Invest)創辦人兼執行長「木頭姐」伍德(Cathie Wood)表示，外資拋售並非源於南韓市場基本面惡化，而是由機械式的程式交易與匯率波動所致。
伍德與韓華資產管理副社長崔永鎮(Choi Young-jin)於首爾63大廈受訪時一致表達此看法，伍德更明確指出，南韓半導體與記憶體類股目前已落入具吸引力的買進區間。

外資撤離非關基本面

針對外資離場的關鍵因素，伍德解釋，今年6月記憶體晶片價格觸頂回落，加上韓元兌美元匯率寫下新高，股價重挫與匯率因素交織，觸發了大規模的機械式程式交易賣壓，南韓市場經濟基本面本身並無致命傷。
伍德強調：「AI革命是一場極為深遠的變革，只要半導體價格開啟復甦行情，基本面終將印證其價值。」
崔永鎮補充說明，外資拋售並不等同於全球資金「看空南韓」。全球投資人結構多元，涵蓋長線機構、避險基金及量化交易員。當股市指數跌破特定臨界閾值時，量化與避險資金便會依法則機械式地減持權重大盤股，進而放大了市場波動。

聚焦高頻寬記憶體與AI升級

談及半導體類股的布局策略，伍德透露，方舟投資過去一向盡量避開競爭激烈的通用型記憶體產品。然而，無論是SK海力士還是三星電子，只要業者加速轉型至高頻寬記憶體(HBM)等高規格產品，方舟便會密切關注其投資機會。
她分析，先前記憶體價格過快上漲打壓了消費性電子銷量，但此負面因素已充分反映在股價中，AI基礎設施長遠前景依舊十分看好。
崔永鎮則剖析了記憶體產業的結構性轉型。他指出，記憶體過去是傳統的周期性產業，隨價格起伏增減產能；但在HBM問世後，記憶體已轉變為根據客戶需求客製化開發、並提前鎖定訂單的核心元件。遺憾的是，目前資本市場仍習慣以舊有的傳統周期眼光評估記憶體類股，從而低估了其長期價值。

給個人投資者的操作建議

對於深陷套牢虧損的個人投資人，伍德建議，若持續看好AI周期，應適度精簡投資組合，賣出缺乏基本面支撐、高估值或失去信心的資產(例如部分加密貨幣)，將資金轉向基本面強韌的核心記憶體股。
她提醒投資人應恪守「低買高賣」的基本紀律，保持能讓自己睡得安穩的適當持股比重，避免借錢追高或盲目跟風。
paras_en: South Korea's stock market has recently slipped sharply due to significant foreign selling pressure, with semiconductor stocks undergoing a steep correction. In response, Ark Invest founder and CEO Cathie Wood said the foreign sell‑off is not caused by a deterioration in South Korea's fundamentals, but by mechanical algorithmic trading and currency fluctuations.

Wood and Choi Young‑jin, vice‑president of Hanwha Asset Management, voiced the same view during an interview at Seoul's 63 Building, with Wood explicitly stating that South Korean semiconductor and memory stocks are now in an attractive buying zone.

Foreign outflows are not fundamentals‑related. Wood explained that memory‑chip prices peaked and fell back in June, while the won hit a new high against the dollar. The combination of price drops and currency moves triggered massive algorithmic sell pressure, but the underlying economic fundamentals of the South Korean market remain intact.
Wood emphasized: "The AI revolution is a profoundly transformative shift; as long as semiconductor prices resume an uptrend, fundamentals will ultimately validate their value."

Choi added that foreign selling does not equal a global bearish stance on South Korea. Global investors are diverse, including long‑term institutions, hedge funds and quant traders. When an index falls below a certain threshold, quant and hedge funds mechanically reduce exposure to large‑cap stocks, amplifying market volatility.

Focusing on high‑bandwidth memory and AI upgrades, Wood said Ark typically avoids highly competitive commodity‑type memory products. However, whether it’s SK Hynix or Samsung Electronics, if a company accelerates its shift toward high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) and other high‑spec products, Ark will closely monitor the investment opportunity.
She noted that earlier rapid memory price hikes had suppressed consumer‑electronics sales, but that downside is already priced in. The long‑term outlook for AI infrastructure remains very positive.

Choi dissected the structural shift in the memory industry. He said memory was once a traditional cyclical business that adjusted capacity with price swings, but after HBM’s emergence, memory has become a core component developed to customer specifications and pre‑booked orders. Unfortunately, capital markets still evaluate memory stocks through an outdated cyclical lens, undervaluing their long‑term worth.

For individual investors stuck in losing positions, Wood advises that if they remain bullish on the AI cycle, they should trim their portfolios, sell assets lacking fundamental support, high valuations or confidence (such as certain cryptocurrencies), and reallocate capital to fundamentally strong core memory stocks.
She reminds investors to stick to the basic discipline of "buy low, sell high," maintain a comfortable stake that lets them sleep well, and avoid borrowing to chase highs or following the crowd.

items.title: AI泡沫真的來了？投資大師馬克斯點出還缺一個訊號
items.title_en: Is the AI Bubble Really Here? Investor Howard Marks Says One Signal Is Still Missing
paras: 愈來愈多億萬富豪與市場人士警告，AI熱潮正將股市推向泡沫邊緣，橡樹資本聯合董事長馬克斯（Howard Marks）卻提出不同看法：當人人都在警惕泡沫，代表投資人尚未忽視風險，即使泡沫存在，也可能受到一定抑制。
每當那斯達克100指數創下歷史新高，新聞報導提及「網路泡沫」的次數便會激增，本月稍早也是如此。這股不安情緒，或許有助於解釋上周市場賣壓為何導致該指數下跌5.5%。
然而，如果這確實是一場泡沫，華爾街投資人卻發現，它比以往更難界定。
本益比未飆升 泡沫疑慮從何而來？
以最簡單的本益比來看，標普500、那斯達克100等指標指數的預估本益比，今年並未像25年前網路泡沫時期一樣飆至明顯過熱的水準，反而因市場預期獲利將大幅成長而下降。
事實上，2000年股市見頂前一個月，標普500前五大科技股的平均預估本益比約為65倍，如今則約23倍。
那麼，這個市場究竟有哪些特徵，讓這麼多人嗅到泡沫？如果他們判斷正確，又會是什麼因素引爆泡沫？
市場專家指出多項過熱跡象，包括高昂債務、難以持續的獲利成長預期，以及與過往泡沫相似的市場氛圍。
橡樹資本聯合董事長馬克斯（Howard Marks）表示：「如果只能挑出一個泡沫特徵，或許就是這個：它成為全民狂熱，有些人因此賺進驚人財富，而沒參與的人覺得自己很蠢，懊悔不已。」
馬克斯曾精準預警網路泡沫頂點，去年也警告自己正「密切留意泡沫」。
他表示，泡沫是個「模糊不定」的概念，但通常意味著市場已升至明顯違背投資人理性判斷的水準，承擔風險的行為與市場情緒也脫離現實。
他在電話訪問中說：「泡沫就是非理性繁榮，就是輕率冒進。『渾然不覺』也是很貼切的形容。」
不過，檢視目前他重視的泡沫指標後，馬克斯尚未認定市場已走到這一步。投資人雖出現害怕錯過科技股進一步上漲的典型心態，但市場不斷拿當前行情與過往泡沫比較，意味著大家並非對風險毫無察覺。
至於投資人是否過度冒進，訊號同樣好壞參半。傳統本益比目前看來並不像泡沫，但若以過去十年獲利計算，估值確實令人警惕。
債務攀升 漲勢過度集中
從技術面來看，交易員指出，目前市場與過往泡沫破裂前存在相似之處，例如股債發行規模創紀錄之際，股市仍展現極強漲勢。其他令人擔憂的數據，還包括同一產業內績優股與落後股表現差距懸殊，以及上漲行情缺乏廣度。
JonesTrading首席市場策略師歐洛克（Michael O’Rourke）認為，大型科技股本益比下滑有其道理，因為這些企業正為建置AI基礎設施大舉舉債。他指出，企業積極提高槓桿時，估值倍數往往會受到壓縮，而這些投資彼此循環的特性，更令人擔憂。
歐洛克受訪時表示：「我們已把供應商融資推向全新層次。」晶片製造商如今必須自行補貼客戶購買自家產品，「否則這些採購根本不會發生」。
另一項令部分投資人警戒的指標，是景氣循環調整本益比（CAPE），亦即以過去十年經通膨調整後的獲利衡量股價。這項指標也常被稱為「席勒本益比」，以耶魯大學經濟學家席勒（Robert Shiller）命名。他在2000年3月出版《非理性繁榮》一書，恰逢股市見頂。
DataTrek Research 共同創辦人柯拉斯（Nicholas Colas）形容該指標是「目前市場上最令人不安的評價圖表」。目前席勒本益比約為 41 倍，距離 1999 年創下的 44 倍歷史高點僅有一步之遙。
此外，市場資金過度集中於頂部企業亦是重大隱憂。如今，輝達(NVDA-US) 、蘋果(AAPL-US) 與微軟(MSFT-US) 這三家全美市值最大的企業，合計已佔標普 500 指數權重約 21%；相對地，1999 年 10 月時需要前 10 大企業相加才能達到相同比重。
儘管各項技術訊號頻發警訊，但過去十年來，那斯達克 100 指數跑贏標普 500 指數高達 250 個百分點的驚人超額報酬仍難以令人忽視。
資深投資人保森（Jim Paulsen）坦言：「即使對科技股感到有些不安，你也無法割捨它。放棄科技股簡直顯得愚蠢，因為它總是能帶來超額回報。」
AI熱潮下的投資狂熱
投資人情緒是許多泡沫觀察人士的重要檢查項目，但今年無論機構或散戶，都遠稱不上狂熱。通膨居高不下、期中選舉的不確定性，以及伊朗戰爭，讓交易員在2026年多次轉向防禦，那斯達克100指數也歷經數波回檔，並一度修正達10%。
不過，仍有跡象顯示，投資人對AI革命帶來的市場機會感到亢奮，例如企業光是更名，就能推升股價。就連這波榮景最大受惠企業之一的掌舵者，也點出這股狂熱氛圍。
博通(AVGO-US) 執行長陳福陽表示，AI熱潮吸引了一批「根本不知道自己在投資什麼」的投資人，行為宛如置身賭場。
另一項經常被提及的泡沫警訊，則來自生活軼事：與服務業人員偶然交談，話題竟轉向投資。
甘迺迪（Joseph Kennedy）最廣為流傳的說法之一，就是1929年連擦鞋童都開始提供股票明牌時，他便知道該賣出了。
CFRA首席投資策略師史托瓦（Sam Stovall）最近也有類似經歷。他表示，與紐約一名報攤經營者聊天時，對方請他列印英特爾與思科等AI相關企業的股票研究報告。
信用市場可能成為引爆點
無論關注哪一項警訊，隨著這波多頭市場邁入第五年，華爾街對泡沫的討論愈來愈頻繁。
彭博行業研究彙整的數據顯示，第二季財報季期間，包括高盛(GS-US) 、亞德諾(ADI-US) 與黑石(BX-US) 在內，共有15場投資人電話會議中，企業高層與分析師談及當前市場與2008年全球金融危機及科技泡沫的相似之處。
與此同時，利率已攀升至可能讓昔日市場寵兒陷入困境的水準。CoreWeave, Inc. Class A(CRWV-US) 股價從1月至5月初一度接近翻倍，但隨著其債券殖利率上升，上周股價重挫後，今年以來的漲幅已轉為跌幅。
Reynolds Strategy首席市場策略師雷諾茲（Brian Reynolds）表示：「通常是信用市場出了問題，才讓循環走向終點。當人們在信用市場收到追繳保證金通知，卻無力補足時，真正的麻煩就開始了。」
當人們深信科技能改變世界，並將這份信念轉化為股市投資狂熱時，泡沫也可能走向破裂。
JonesTrading的歐洛克表示，投資人「變得過度自信，接著付出過高價格。這才是泡沫思維的本質，並不是說AI不會改變世界」。
以網際網路崛起等過往案例來看，技術本身確實極為成功，也帶來深遠變革；股市上漲則促使企業透過首次公開發行（IPO）與增資，大幅增加股票供給。然而，當獲利不如預期、利率走高，原本集中於少數股票的漲勢便開始逆轉。
不過，馬克斯目前尚未看到一項關鍵泡沫特徵，就是投資人對風險「渾然不覺」。事實上，華爾街似乎人人都在談論潛在泡沫。
馬克斯表示：「如果有夠多人謹慎思考某個領域是否存在泡沫，那麼，即使它真的是泡沫，規模可能也受到一定抑制，這樣的判斷完全合理。」
paras_en: More and more billionaires and market participants are warning that the AI frenzy is pushing the stock market to the edge of a bubble, but Howard Marks, co‑chairman of Oaktree Capital, offers a different view: when everyone is warning about a bubble, it means investors have not ignored the risk, and even if a bubble exists it may be somewhat restrained.

Whenever the Nasdaq‑100 hits a record high, mentions of a "dot‑com bubble" in the news surge, and that was the case earlier this month. This nervousness may help explain why last week’s selling pressure knocked the index down 5.5%.
However, if this truly is a bubble, Wall Street investors are finding it harder to define than before.
PE ratios haven’t surged – where do the bubble worries come from?

Looking at the simplest metric, the forward PE of the S&P 500, Nasdaq‑100 and other indices has not jumped to the overheated levels seen 25 years ago during the dot‑com era; instead it has fallen as the market expects earnings to grow sharply.
In fact, a month before the market peaked in 2000, the average forward PE of the S&P 500’s five biggest tech stocks was about 65×; today it is roughly 23×.
So what characteristics of today’s market are making so many people smell a bubble? If they are right, what could trigger it?
Market experts point to several overheating signs, including high debt levels, unsustainable earnings‑growth expectations, and a market atmosphere reminiscent of past bubbles.

Howard Marks said, "If I had to pick one bubble characteristic, it would be this: it becomes a nationwide craze, some people make astonishing fortunes, and those who don’t participate feel foolish and regretful."
Marks famously warned of the dot‑com peak and last year said he was "watching bubbles closely."

He notes that a bubble is a "fuzzy" concept but usually means the market has risen to a level that clearly defies rational investor judgment, with risk‑taking behavior and sentiment detached from reality.
In a phone interview he said, "A bubble is irrational exuberance, reckless over‑extension. 'Being oblivious' is also a very apt description."

Nevertheless, after reviewing the bubble indicators he tracks, Marks does not yet see the market at that point. Investors are showing the typical fear‑of‑missing‑out on further tech gains, but the constant comparison of today’s market with past bubbles shows they are not blind to risk.
As for whether investors are over‑reaching, the signals are mixed. Traditional PE ratios don’t look bubble‑like, but when earnings over the past ten years are used, valuations do raise alarms.
Rising debt and overly concentrated rallies

From a technical standpoint, traders note similarities between today’s market and periods before past bubble bursts, such as record‑size equity‑and‑debt issuances while stocks still surge. Other worrying data include widening performance gaps between leading and lagging stocks in the same sector and a rally lacking breadth.

Michael O’Rourke, chief market strategist at JonesTrading, says the decline in PE multiples for large tech stocks makes sense because these firms are taking on massive debt to build AI infrastructure. He points out that when companies aggressively increase leverage, valuation multiples tend to compress, and the cyclical nature of these investments is concerning.
O’Rourke added, "We have pushed supplier financing to a whole new level." Chip makers now have to subsidise customers’ purchases of their own products, "or those purchases would never happen."

Another metric that alarms some investors is the cyclically‑adjusted PE (CAPE), which measures price relative to ten‑year inflation‑adjusted earnings. It is also known as the "Shiller PE" after Yale economist Robert Shiller, who published "Irrational Exuberance" in March 2000 just as the market peaked.

Nicholas Colas, co‑founder of DataTrek Research, calls the CAPE chart "the most unsettling valuation chart in the market today." The current Shiller PE is about 41×, just a hair away from the 44× historic high set in 1999.

In addition, capital is overly concentrated in a few top‑tier companies. Today Nvidia (NVDA‑US), Apple (AAPL‑US) and Microsoft (MSFT‑US) together account for roughly 21% of the S&P 500’s weight, whereas in October 1999 it took the top ten firms combined to reach the same share.
Even with all these technical warning signs, the Nasdaq‑100’s outperformance of the S&P 500 by an astonishing 250 percentage points over the past decade remains hard to ignore.
Veteran investor Jim Paulsen admits, "Even if you feel a little uneasy about tech stocks, you can’t walk away. Abandoning tech would be foolish because it consistently delivers excess returns."
The AI‑driven investment frenzy

Investor sentiment is a key bubble gauge, yet this year neither institutions nor retail traders have been truly manic. Persistent inflation, mid‑term election uncertainty and the Iran war have pushed traders to adopt defensive stances throughout 2026, causing the Nasdaq‑100 to pull back several times and at one point correct by 10%.

Nevertheless, there are signs investors are excited about the market opportunities of the AI revolution, such as companies seeing their stock price jump simply by rebranding. Even the CEO of one of the biggest beneficiaries of the boom has noted the hype.
Broadcom (AVGO‑US) CEO Chen Fu‑yang said the AI craze has attracted a crowd of investors "who have no idea what they are investing in," behaving as if they were in a casino.
Another frequently cited bubble warning comes from everyday anecdotes: casual conversations with service‑industry workers suddenly turn to investment topics.
One of the most widely quoted sayings from Joseph Kennedy is that in 1929, when even shoe‑polishers were giving stock tips, he knew it was time to sell.

Sam Stovall, chief investment strategist at CFRA, recently had a similar experience. He recounted that a New York newsstand owner asked him to print research reports on AI‑related stocks such as Intel and Cisco.
Credit markets could be the spark
Regardless of which warning you focus on, as this bull market enters its fifth year, discussions of a bubble on Wall Street are becoming more frequent.

Bloomberg industry research shows that during the second‑quarter earnings season, in 15 investor conference calls that included firms like Goldman Sachs (GS‑US), Analog Devices (ADI‑US) and Blackstone (BX‑US), senior executives and analysts drew parallels between today’s market and the 2008 global financial crisis and the tech bubble.

At the same time, rates have risen to levels that could trouble former market darlings. CoreWeave, Inc. Class A (CRWV‑US) saw its share price nearly double from January to early May, but as its bond yields climbed, the stock slumped last week and its year‑to‑date gain has turned into a loss.

Brian Reynolds, chief market strategist at Reynolds Strategy, warned, "Usually it’s a problem in the credit market that pushes the cycle to its end. When people get margin calls in the credit market and can’t meet them, the real trouble starts."
When people are convinced that technology will change the world and turn that belief into a stock‑market frenzy, a bubble can eventually burst.
O’Rourke of JonesTrading says investors "become over‑confident and then pay too high a price. That’s the essence of bubble thinking, not a claim that AI won’t change the world."

Looking at past cases such as the rise of the internet, the technology itself was undeniably successful and transformative; the stock rally helped companies raise capital through IPOs and secondary offerings, flooding the market with shares. Yet when earnings fall short and rates climb, the concentrated rally in a handful of stocks can reverse.
However, Marks still does not see one key bubble trait: investors being completely oblivious to risk. In fact, everyone on Wall Street seems to be talking about a potential bubble.
Marks concludes, "If enough people carefully consider whether a sector is in a bubble, then even if it is, its size may be somewhat restrained. That judgment is entirely reasonable."

items.title: 印尼股票市場拋售加劇 並蔓延至債券與印尼盾
items.title_en: Indonesia Stock Market Sell‑Off Intensifies and Spreads to Bonds and Rupiah
paras: 印尼雅加達綜合指數(JCI)持續下挫，周一(19日)盤中一度重挫5.4%，延續上周五崩跌12%的頹勢。此次下跌，主要受到指數編算公司摩根士丹利資本國際(MSCI Inc.)發出潛在降級警告影響。
相關衝擊造成印尼金融市場拋售潮全面擴大，股市陷入近30年來最嚴重暴跌，賣壓並迅速延燒至債券與印尼盾匯市。
MSCI 上周五表示，出於可投資性等疑慮，正考慮將印尼從「新興市場」直接降級至「獨立市場」，此舉遠超今年1月警示降至「邊境市場」的幅度。措手不及的印尼官方已安排於周一與 MSCI 高層會面尋求釐清。
高盛估算，若印尼被完全剔除，可能觸發約56億美元的被動型資金撤出，若富時羅素(FTSE Russell)跟進，恐再面臨27億美元流出風險。2026年截至目前，外資已從印尼股市淨撤出51億美元，創下歷史最大年度外流紀錄。
針對市場崩盤與資金外逃，新加坡東斯銀行(SEB)亞洲策略主管 Eugenia Victorino 指出：「外資正全線撤離印尼股市，債市也感受到熱度。印尼盾走弱正侵蝕實質殖利率，在匯率止穩前，全球資金寧可安全地位於場外觀望。」
PT MNC Sekuritas 分析師 Herditya Wicaksana 表示：「賣壓依然顯著，特別是像大型銀行這類對雅加達綜合指數影響巨大的股票。」
星展集團(DBS Group) 警告，衝擊可能進一步蔓延並緊縮融資條件，推升10年期國債殖利率邁向7.5%，並促使印尼央行再升息50至100個基點。
為遏止跌勢，印尼證券交易所周一緊急調緊單一股票每日最大跌幅限制，由15%縮減至7%，施行至今年底
。企業端也展開自救，富豪 Prajogo Pangestu 旗下三家公司計畫合計買回2.5兆印尼盾(約1.38億美元)庫藏股；金光集團旗下 PT Dian Swastatika Sentosa 也提議買回1兆印尼盾股票。
paras_en: Indonesia’s Jakarta Composite Index (JCI) kept sliding, plunging as much as 5.4% during Monday’s (the 19th) session, extending the 12% crash that began last Friday. The drop was mainly triggered by a potential downgrade warning issued by the index‑calculating firm MSCI Inc.

The fallout sparked a broad sell‑off across Indonesia’s financial markets, with the equity market experiencing its steepest plunge in nearly 30 years and selling pressure quickly spilling over into bonds and the rupiah foreign‑exchange market.

MSCI said on Friday that, due to concerns over investability, it is considering moving Indonesia from the “Emerging Markets” category directly to “Standalone Market,” a step far beyond the warning in January that it might be demoted to a “Frontier Market.” Caught off guard, Indonesian officials have arranged a meeting with senior MSCI officials on Monday to seek clarification.

Goldman Sachs estimates that a full removal of Indonesia could trigger about $5.6 billion of passive‑fund outflows, and if FTSE Russell follows suit, another $2.7 billion could flee. To date in 2026, foreign investors have net‑withdrawn $5.1 billion from Indonesia’s stock market, setting a record for the largest annual outflow.

Commenting on the market crash and capital flight, Eugenia Victorino, head of Asian strategy at Singapore’s SEB, said: “Foreign investors are pulling out of Indonesian equities across the board, and the bond market is feeling the heat. A weaker rupiah is eroding real yields, and until the currency stabilises, global capital would rather stay safely off‑exchange and wait.”
Herditya Wicaksana, an analyst at PT MNC Sekuritas, noted: “Selling pressure remains significant, especially in stocks like large banks that have a huge impact on the Jakarta Composite Index.”

DBS Group warned that the shock could spread further and tighten financing conditions, pushing the 10‑year government bond yield toward 7.5% and prompting the Bank of Indonesia to raise rates by another 50 to 100 basis points.

To curb the decline, the Indonesia Stock Exchange on Monday urgently tightened the daily maximum price‑move limit for individual stocks, cutting it from 15% to 7% effective through the end of the year.

Companies are also taking self‑help measures: billionaire Prajogo Pangestu’s three firms plan to repurchase a total of 2.5 trillion rupiah (about $138 million) of shares, and PT Dian Swastatika Sentosa of the Golden Light Group has proposed buying back 1 trillion rupiah of stock.

items.title: 伊朗促美接受「7日提議」重啟荷姆茲海峽
items.title_en: Iran urges US to accept "7-day proposal" to reopen the Hormuz Strait
paras: 在中東局勢持續緊張與核武談判陷入僵局之際，伊朗政府周日(18日)再次呼籲美國接受其提出的條件，以重啟封鎖已久的荷姆茲海峽。
伊朗外交部長阿拉格奇(Abbas Araghchi)在巴格達出席伊斯蘭合作組織(OIC)會議期間表示，只要華府接受伊朗提出的條件，荷姆茲海峽即可在第6天重啟，雙方並能在第7天恢復談判。阿拉格奇強調，這項「7日提議」目前仍擺在檯面上，德黑蘭正在審閱美方傳達的反饋意見。
阿拉格奇對媒體表示：「我們的立場相當明確且建立在呈交給美國的7日提議上。若美方展現任何誠意——雖然他們並沒有——那麼重啟荷姆茲海峽的路徑顯而易見。」
伊朗提出的重啟條件包括：美方必須解除對伊朗港口的海上封鎖、撤銷對伊朗石油出口的制裁、解凍伊朗部分海外資產，並停止所有區域戰線上的敵對行動。
荷姆茲海峽在衝突爆發前承載了全球約五分之一(20%)的石油與液化天然氣(LNG)運輸，其持續關閉已對全球經濟造成顯著衝擊。
然而，美伊兩國在談判優先順序上存在嚴重分歧。美國主張談判一開始就必須處理伊朗的核子計畫，美國副總統范斯(JD Vance)指出，伊朗必須「大幅度」削減其鈾濃縮能力，才能滿足美方要求並結束這場已持續8個月的戰爭。相對地，德黑蘭則堅持初期談判應先集中於重啟荷姆茲海峽及恢復此一水道的安全。
另一方面，剛獲伊朗議會高票通過任命的新任國防部長阿赫拉吉(Mehrdad Akhlaghi)對華府發出嚴正警告。阿赫拉吉受訪時表示：「民眾可以放心，美方極可能不敢攻擊我們。如果他們重啟軍事行動，美國及其區域盟友將遭受『極其嚴重的損害』。」
paras_en: Amid ongoing Middle‑East tensions and a stalemate in nuclear talks, Iran’s government on Sunday (the 18th) again called on the United States to accept its conditions to reopen the long‑blocked Strait of Hormuz.

Iran’s foreign minister Abbas Araghchi said during an OIC meeting in Baghdad that if Washington accepts Iran’s terms, the Strait of Hormuz could be reopened on day 6 and negotiations could resume on day 7. He stressed that the “7‑day proposal” remains on the table and Tehran is reviewing the feedback it has received from the U.S.

Araghchi told reporters, “Our position is crystal clear and is based on the 7‑day proposal we submitted to the United States. If the U.S. shows any sincerity – which it has not – the path to reopening the Strait of Hormuz is obvious.”

Iran’s reopening conditions include: the U.S. must lift the maritime blockade of Iranian ports, lift sanctions on Iranian oil exports, unfreeze part of Iran’s overseas assets, and cease all hostile actions on regional fronts.
Before the conflict, the Strait of Hormuz carried about one‑fifth (20%) of the world’s oil and LNG shipments, and its continued closure has dealt a significant blow to the global economy.

However, the United States and Iran are at odds over negotiation priorities. The U.S. insists that talks must start with Iran’s nuclear program, with Vice President JD Vance saying Iran must “substantially” cut its uranium enrichment capacity to meet U.S. demands and end the war that has lasted eight months. Tehran, by contrast, argues that early talks should focus on reopening the Strait of Hormuz and restoring its security.

Meanwhile, newly appointed defence minister Mehrdad Akhlaghi, confirmed by a high‑vote in the Iranian parliament, warned Washington sternly. Akhlaghi said in an interview, “The public can be assured that the U.S. is unlikely to dare attack us. If they resume military action, the United States and its regional allies will suffer ‘extremely severe damage.’”

items.title: 跟低薪族一樣？年薪1500萬者 近四成自稱「月光族」
items.title_en: Like Low‑Income Earners? Nearly 40% of Those Making 15 Million TWD Annually Claim They’re “Living Pay‑check to Pay‑check”
paras: 無論是高所得還是低所得者，兩者之間至少有一個共同點：比起中產階級，他們更常自嘲是「月光族」。
高盛資產管理與行為經濟學公司 Escalent 於 7 月對美國民眾進行的調查顯示，年收入低於 5 萬美元的在職受訪者中，約 61% 表示主要靠每月薪水度日，難以存錢或朝長期財務目標邁進。
年收入介於 10 萬至 20 萬美元者，這一比率降至 22%；但年收入超過 50 萬美元者，比率又回升至約 37%。
報告指出，個人的財務安全感並非隨收入增加呈線性上升，而是呈現顯著的「U型曲線」。
低薪族苦於生計 通膨壓力雪上加霜
不過，收入最高與最低的族群，面臨的挑戰並不相同。
低收入族群連基本生活開銷都難以負擔。皮尤研究中心（Pew Research Center）調查發現，42% 的美國低收入成年人難以負擔日常交通費用，另有 39% 表示支付房租或房貸有困難。
高油價讓情況更加艱難，汽油價格漲幅較伊朗戰爭爆發前加快。包括日常採買食品在內的居家食品價格，漲勢雖較緩和，卻仍持續上升。
亞特蘭大聯準銀行的追蹤指標也顯示，購屋所需收入與實際家庭所得中位數之間的差距進一步擴大。
高薪族受制奢華生活 成本排擠退休儲蓄
相對地，年收入超過 30 萬美元的高所得者，則面臨著更複雜的財務生活、更高的生活品質期待、金額龐大的固定開銷，以及「理想中的退休生活」與「現實已累積的資產」之間的落差。
高盛資產管理資深退休策略師 Chris Ceder 表示，生活開銷隨收入提高而膨脹，也可能是原因之一。
這種「U型現象」幾乎無所不在。調查指出，按收入區分，財務焦慮影響工作專注度、信用卡卡債壓力、以及被迫延後財務目標的比例，均呈現 U 型分佈。
令人意外的是，收入最高族群中，竟有高達 45% 的人在保有工作的同時，仍坦言不得不延後退休計畫，此比例居所有收入層級之冠。
當被問及儲蓄退休金的最大阻礙時，整體受訪者中有 31% 歸咎於住房成本，31% 認為是日常生活開銷，27% 則指向債務負擔。
報告指出，這些開銷每月按時報到且無法延後，永遠被優先支付，導致退休準備往往被排在最後。其中，高所得者最關心住房、家庭照顧與醫療費用，低所得者則以債務管理為首要痛點。
高薪族兼差盛行 積極布局退休資產
更有趣的是，高所得者兼職或從事副業的比例竟然最高，這與大眾對低收入者才需要兼差的刻板印象正好相反。
人力資源平台 ZipRecruiter 今年早期的調查顯示，年薪超過 15 萬美元的受訪者中，高達 45% 擁有副業或額外收入來源，反觀年薪 2.5 萬至 5 萬美元者僅佔 31%。
Ceder 表示，高收入者積極兼差，可能反映他們清楚自己的長期財務目標，並希望提早做好準備。他們其實對最終達成退休目標頗具信心，而這些兼職所得，很大一部分正是用來充實他們的退休基金。
paras_en: Regardless of whether they earn high or low incomes, both groups share at least one commonality: compared to the middle class, they are more likely to joke that they are "living pay‑check to pay‑check."

A July survey by Goldman Sachs Asset Management and behavioral‑economics firm Escalent of U.S. residents found that among employed respondents earning less than $50,000 a year, about 61% said they mainly live off their monthly paychecks, finding it hard to save or move toward long‑term financial goals.
For those earning between $100,000 and $200,000, that percentage fell to 22%; but for those earning more than $500,000, the figure rose again to roughly 37%.
The report notes that an individual’s sense of financial security does not rise linearly with income, but instead follows a pronounced "U‑shaped" curve.
Low‑income earners struggle to make ends meet, with inflation adding to the burden.
However, the challenges faced by the highest‑ and lowest‑income groups differ.

Low‑income groups find even basic living expenses difficult to afford. A Pew Research Center survey found that 42% of low‑income U.S. adults struggle to pay everyday transportation costs, and 39% say they have trouble paying rent or a mortgage.

High gasoline prices make the situation even harder, with fuel price increases accelerating faster than before the Iran war. While household food prices—including everyday grocery purchases—have risen more slowly, they remain on an upward trend.
Atlanta Fed tracking indicators also show that the gap between the income needed to buy a home and the actual median household income is widening further.
High‑income earners are constrained by luxury lifestyles, with costs crowding out retirement savings.

In contrast, those earning over $300,000 face a more complex financial life, higher expectations for quality of life, large fixed expenses, and a gap between their "ideal retirement" and the assets they have actually accumulated.
Senior retirement strategist Chris Ceder of Goldman Sachs Asset Management says that living expenses inflate with income, which may be one reason for this.

This "U‑shaped phenomenon" is almost ubiquitous. The survey found that, by income bracket, financial anxiety affects work focus, credit‑card debt pressure, and the proportion of people forced to delay financial goals, all following a U‑shaped distribution.
Surprisingly, among the highest‑income group, as many as 45% admit to delaying retirement plans while still holding jobs, the highest proportion across all income levels.
When asked what the biggest barrier to saving for retirement was, 31% of respondents overall blamed housing costs, 31% cited everyday living expenses, and 27% pointed to debt burdens.

The report notes that these expenses are paid on time each month and cannot be postponed, so retirement preparation is often left last. High‑income earners are most concerned about housing, family care, and medical costs, while low‑income earners prioritize debt management.
High‑income earners frequently take on side jobs, actively building retirement assets.
Interestingly, the proportion of high‑income earners with side jobs or additional income streams is the highest, contrary to the stereotype that only low‑income workers need side jobs.

A ZipRecruiter survey early this year showed that among respondents earning over $150,000, as many as 45% have side jobs or extra income sources, compared with only 31% among those earning between $25,000 and $50,000.

Ceder says that high‑income earners’ active side‑job pursuit may reflect their clear understanding of long‑term financial goals and a desire to prepare early. They are actually confident about ultimately achieving retirement goals, and a large portion of their side‑job income is used to bolster their retirement funds.

items.title: 局勢嚴峻下很招！德媒：福斯擬將全球60萬員工薪資「凍漲」至2030年
items.title_en: Amid a Severe Situation, a Bold Move: German Media Says Volkswagen Plans to Freeze Salaries for 600,000 Global Employees Until 2030
paras: 德媒最新報導指出，福斯打算在2030年之前，凍結其全球60萬名員工中大部分人的薪資，發言人則稱不對此類報導置評，即將展開的新一輪談判才是討論內部營運協議的合適場合。
《南德意志報》周日(18日)根據一份面向福斯全球高層內部文件報導指出，鑑於集團面臨的「嚴峻形勢」，全球範圍內的集體談判將適用新指導方針，並從今年第四季起生效，核心措施包括暫停加薪至2030年，削減可變薪資、特別津貼和福利，提高生產效率、增加工時彈性及縮減加班，非生產部門也可能進行裁員。不過，文件也強調將兼顧各業務分支的實際經營環境，未必在所有地區強制推行薪資「凍漲」。
在德國，受全公司集體談判協議涵蓋的13萬名員工，作為2024年成本削減方案的一部分，此前已同意推遲原定5.5%的加薪。由於通貨膨脹，多年不調薪未來幾年將讓德國員工的實際收入減少多達10%。
薪資凍結是福斯「集團願景」策略文件的一部分，已獲管理層批准，將用於國際勞資談判，這更是其大規模降本計畫的最新一環。
今年9月，福斯監事會正式批准「2030未來計畫」，確認將全球裁員規模擴大至10萬人，約佔員工總數的15%，並關閉包括德國4家工廠在內的多家工廠，全球產能從1200萬輛下調至900萬輛。
今年6月，《路透社》曾披露裁員可能從5萬人擴大至10萬人，稱這將是汽車工業史上最大規模的重組。
福斯近期下調業績預期，理由是市場急劇萎縮，該公司正面臨中國本土新能源品牌快速蠶食份額、歐洲能源價格高漲、電動轉型成本龐大，以及美國關稅政策不確定性等多重壓力。
paras_en: German media reports that Volkswagen intends to freeze the salaries of most of its 600,000 employees worldwide until 2030. A spokesperson declined to comment on the reports, saying that the upcoming round of negotiations will be the appropriate forum to discuss internal operating agreements.

The Süddeutsche Zeitung reported on Sunday (the 18th) that, based on an internal document addressed to Volkswagen’s senior global management, the group will apply new guidelines to collective bargaining worldwide in light of the "severe situation" it faces. The guidelines, effective from the fourth quarter of this year, include suspending wage increases until 2030, cutting variable pay, special allowances and benefits, improving productivity, increasing work‑time flexibility and reducing overtime, and possibly laying off staff in non‑production units. The document also stresses that the measures will be adapted to the actual operating conditions of each business unit and may not be enforced uniformly across all regions.

In Germany, 130,000 employees covered by a company‑wide collective agreement have already agreed, as part of a 2024 cost‑cutting plan, to postpone a scheduled 5.5% wage increase. Because of inflation, the lack of pay adjustments over several years will erode German workers’ real earnings by up to 10% in the coming years.

The salary freeze is part of Volkswagen’s "Group Vision" strategy document, which has been approved by management and will be used in international labor negotiations. It represents the latest step in the company’s large‑scale cost‑reduction programme.

In September, Volkswagen’s supervisory board formally approved the "2030 Future Plan," confirming that global layoffs will be expanded to 100,000 jobs – about 15% of the workforce – and that several factories, including four in Germany, will be closed, reducing global production capacity from 12 million vehicles to 9 million.
In June, Reuters disclosed that the layoff figure could rise from 50,000 to 100,000, describing it as the biggest restructuring in automotive industry history.

Volkswagen has recently lowered its earnings outlook, citing a sharp market contraction. The company is under pressure from rapidly gaining market share by domestic Chinese new‑energy brands, soaring energy prices in Europe, the high cost of the electric‑vehicle transition, and uncertainty surrounding U.S. tariff policy.

items.title: 輝達柏林GTC大會周二登場！黃仁勳21日登台主題演說　AI工廠、歐洲投資引關注
items.title_en: NVIDIA Berlin GTC Conference Kicks Off Tuesday! Jensen Huang to Deliver Keynote on the 21st – AI Factories and European Investment in Spotlight
paras: 為期三天的輝達GTC大會周二(20日)將在德國柏林登場，執行長黃仁勳定於周三發表主題演講，本屆大會議題超過百場，重心明顯從「賣GPU」推向「賣AI工廠」，涵蓋加速運算、智能體AI、物理AI、機器人、開源模型與AI基礎設施。
市場關注焦點落在Vera Rubin平台實際部署進度，該平台被輝達定位為面向智能體AI的機架級運算系統，重點不只是單晶片效能，而是雲端服務商是否進入規模化部署、每Token推理成本能否實質下降，投資人也會觀察CoreWeave、谷歌雲、Azure等合作方機架落地情況，判斷AI資本支出是否延續。
歐洲戰略布局是另一主線。黃仁勳日前在巴黎透露，未來一週將宣布約20億美元歐洲新增AI投資或交易。過去一年，輝達在歐洲投入約80億美元，合計規模逼近百億美元。法國Doctolib、Genesis AI等新創公司已列入融資名單，英國多家AI公司也被點名。
根據德國《商報》報導，德國政府正打算與輝達簽署工業AI合作，規模數億歐元，可能與GTC同期宣布，傳參與企業包括西門子、奧迪、Black Forest Labs等十餘家。合作將基於Nemotron語言模型與Cosmos物理AI模型，第一個目標是機器人與自駕車用的物理AI，第二是具國際競爭力的工業場景模型。
對輝達而言，歐洲不只是新客戶市場，更是把平台綁進製造業產線、電信雲與主權AI基礎設施的機會，對歐洲而言則是在依賴美系算力的同時，嘗試換取本地模型與產業數據主導權。
paras_en: The three‑day NVIDIA GTC conference will take place in Berlin, Germany on Tuesday (the 20th), with CEO Jensen Huang slated to give a keynote on Wednesday. This year’s agenda features more than a hundred sessions, shifting the focus from “selling GPUs” to “selling AI factories,” covering accelerated computing, agent AI, physics AI, robotics, open‑source models and AI infrastructure.

Investors are watching the rollout progress of the Vera Rubin platform, which NVIDIA positions as a rack‑scale computing system for agent AI. The emphasis is not just on chip performance but on whether cloud providers are moving to large‑scale deployments and if per‑token inference costs can be materially reduced. Stakeholders will also monitor rack deployments by partners such as CoreWeave, Google Cloud and Azure to gauge whether AI capex will continue.

Europe’s strategic rollout is another key theme. Huang recently disclosed in Paris that within the next week NVIDIA will announce roughly $2 billion of new AI investments or deals in Europe. Over the past year the company has poured about $8 billion into the region, bringing total commitments close to $10 billion. French startups like Doctolib and Genesis AI are on the financing list, and several UK AI firms have also been singled out.

According to Germany’s Handelsblatt, the German government is preparing to sign an industrial AI partnership with NVIDIA worth several hundred million euros, likely to be announced alongside GTC. Participants are said to include Siemens, Audi, Black Forest Labs and more than ten other companies. The collaboration will build on the Nemotron language model and the Cosmos physics‑AI model, with the first goal targeting robotics and autonomous‑vehicle physics AI, and the second aiming at globally competitive industrial‑scenario models.

For NVIDIA, Europe is not just a new customer market but an opportunity to embed its platform into manufacturing lines, telecom clouds and sovereign AI infrastructure. For Europe, it offers a chance to secure local model and industry‑data control while still relying on U.S. compute power.

items.title: 印尼股票市場拋售加劇 並蔓延至債券與印尼盾
items.title_en: Indonesia Stock Market Sell‑Off Intensifies and Spreads to Bonds and Rupiah
paras: 印尼雅加達綜合指數(JCI)持續下挫，周一(19日)盤中一度重挫5.4%，延續上周五崩跌12%的頹勢。此次下跌，主要受到指數編算公司摩根士丹利資本國際(MSCI Inc.)發出潛在降級警告影響。
相關衝擊造成印尼金融市場拋售潮全面擴大，股市陷入近30年來最嚴重暴跌，賣壓並迅速延燒至債券與印尼盾匯市。
MSCI 上周五表示，出於可投資性等疑慮，正考慮將印尼從「新興市場」直接降級至「獨立市場」，此舉遠超今年1月警示降至「邊境市場」的幅度。措手不及的印尼官方已安排於周一與 MSCI 高層會面尋求釐清。
高盛估算，若印尼被完全剔除，可能觸發約56億美元的被動型資金撤出，若富時羅素(FTSE Russell)跟進，恐再面臨27億美元流出風險。2026年截至目前，外資已從印尼股市淨撤出51億美元，創下歷史最大年度外流紀錄。
針對市場崩盤與資金外逃，新加坡東斯銀行(SEB)亞洲策略主管 Eugenia Victorino 指出：「外資正全線撤離印尼股市，債市也感受到熱度。印尼盾走弱正侵蝕實質殖利率，在匯率止穩前，全球資金寧可安全地位於場外觀望。」
PT MNC Sekuritas 分析師 Herditya Wicaksana 表示：「賣壓依然顯著，特別是像大型銀行這類對雅加達綜合指數影響巨大的股票。」
星展集團(DBS Group) 警告，衝擊可能進一步蔓延並緊縮融資條件，推升10年期國債殖利率邁向7.5%，並促使印尼央行再升息50至100個基點。
為遏止跌勢，印尼證券交易所周一緊急調緊單一股票每日最大跌幅限制，由15%縮減至7%，施行至今年底
。企業端也展開自救，富豪 Prajogo Pangestu 旗下三家公司計畫合計買回2.5兆印尼盾(約1.38億美元)庫藏股；金光集團旗下 PT Dian Swastatika Sentosa 也提議買回1兆印尼盾股票。
paras_en: Indonesia’s Jakarta Composite Index (JCI) kept sliding, plunging as much as 5.4% during Monday’s (the 19th) session, extending the 12% crash that began last Friday. The drop was mainly triggered by a potential downgrade warning issued by the index‑calculating firm MSCI Inc.

The fallout sparked a broad sell‑off across Indonesia’s financial markets, with the equity market experiencing its steepest plunge in nearly 30 years and selling pressure quickly spilling over into bonds and the rupiah foreign‑exchange market.

MSCI said on Friday that, due to concerns over investability, it is considering moving Indonesia from the “Emerging Markets” category directly to “Standalone Market,” a step far beyond the warning in January that it might be demoted to a “Frontier Market.” Caught off guard, Indonesian officials have arranged a meeting with senior MSCI officials on Monday to seek clarification.

Goldman Sachs estimates that a full removal of Indonesia could trigger about $5.6 billion of passive‑fund outflows, and if FTSE Russell follows suit, another $2.7 billion could flee. To date in 2026, foreign investors have net‑withdrawn $5.1 billion from Indonesia’s stock market, setting a record for the largest annual outflow.

Commenting on the market crash and capital flight, Eugenia Victorino, head of Asian strategy at Singapore’s SEB, said: “Foreign investors are pulling out of Indonesian equities across the board, and the bond market is feeling the heat. A weaker rupiah is eroding real yields, and until the currency stabilises, global capital would rather stay safely off‑exchange and wait.”
Herditya Wicaksana, an analyst at PT MNC Sekuritas, noted: “Selling pressure remains significant, especially in stocks like large banks that have a huge impact on the Jakarta Composite Index.”

DBS Group warned that the shock could spread further and tighten financing conditions, pushing the 10‑year government bond yield toward 7.5% and prompting the Bank of Indonesia to raise rates by another 50 to 100 basis points.

To curb the decline, the Indonesia Stock Exchange on Monday urgently tightened the daily maximum price‑move limit for individual stocks, cutting it from 15% to 7% effective through the end of the year.

Companies are also taking self‑help measures: billionaire Prajogo Pangestu’s three firms plan to repurchase a total of 2.5 trillion rupiah (about $138 million) of shares, and PT Dian Swastatika Sentosa of the Golden Light Group has proposed buying back 1 trillion rupiah of stock.

items.title: 人工智慧浪潮助推 馬來西亞9月出口額創逾5年新高
items.title_en: AI Wave Boosts Malaysia's September Export Value to Over Five-Year High
paras: 受惠於全球人工智慧(AI)浪潮與資料中心建置帶動的半導體及電子產品需求，馬來西亞今年9月外貿展現強勁成長力道，出口額刷新逾5年來最高紀錄。
根據馬來西亞統計局(DOSM)與投資貿易暨工業部(MITI)公布的最新數據，馬來西亞9月出口額達2,151億令吉(約合450億美元)，年增54.5%，表現遠超出《路透》調查預期的44.6%及《彭博》預估的39.9%。
在進出口同步雙位數成長帶動下，9月總貿易額年增53.7%至3,965億令吉。進口額則年增52.7%至1,814億令吉，高於市場預期的39%，9月貿易順差擴大約65%至337億令吉，高於預期的316億令吉。
統計局資料顯示，進口擴張主要由生產輸入端需求強勁所推升，其中中間財進口大增69.6%至921億令吉，資本財與消費財進口亦分別成長20.9%及18.2%。
從主要出口商品來看，占總出口半數以上的電子與電器產品(E&E)9月出口額年增率高達68%至69.2%，創下單月歷史新高。包含半導體測試儀器在內的光學與科學設備出口額亦同步登頂。
出口市場方面，對台灣出口年增率高達175.2%(成長超過一倍)，對美國出口成長89.9%，對中國出口則成長22.1%。相對地，受棕櫚油出口減少拖累，農業出口年減5.7%。
針對未來外貿展望，馬來西亞投資貿工部在官方聲明中特別警示：「馬來西亞的貿易表現仍面臨主要經濟體貿易政策轉變及地緣政治緊張局勢帶來的不確定性。」
MITI 分析，尤其是中東地區持續的衝突可能打亂全球貿易流動並加劇成本壓力。MITI 表示未來將持續「評估相關發展、加強市場多元化、擴大進入高成長市場，並協助馬來西亞出口商進行調整」，以增強外貿抗風險能力。
paras_en: Benefiting from the global artificial intelligence (AI) wave and the demand for semiconductors and electronic products driven by data‑center construction, Malaysia’s foreign trade showed strong growth in September, with export value reaching a record high not seen in more than five years.

According to the latest data released by Malaysia’s Department of Statistics (DOSM) and the Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI), September export value hit RM215.1 billion (about US$45 billion), up 54.5% year‑on‑year, far exceeding Reuters’ forecast of 44.6% and Bloomberg’s estimate of 39.9%.

With both imports and exports posting double‑digit growth, total trade in September rose 53.7% year‑on‑year to RM396.5 billion. Imports increased 52.7% to RM181.4 billion, above the market’s 39% expectation, and the trade surplus widened about 65% to RM33.7 billion, higher than the anticipated RM31.6 billion.

Statistics show that the import expansion was mainly driven by strong demand for production inputs, with intermediate goods imports surging 69.6% to RM92.1 billion, while capital goods and consumer goods imports grew 20.9% and 18.2% respectively.

Looking at major export commodities, electronic and electrical (E&E) products, which account for more than half of total exports, posted a year‑on‑year growth of 68% to RM69.2 billion, setting a new monthly historical high. Exports of optical and scientific equipment, including semiconductor testing instruments, also hit record levels.

In terms of export markets, shipments to Taiwan jumped 175.2% year‑on‑year (more than double), to the United States grew 89.9%, and to China rose 22.1%. Conversely, agricultural exports fell 5.7% year‑on‑year due to a drop in palm‑oil shipments.

Regarding the outlook, MITI warned in an official statement that “Malaysia’s trade performance still faces uncertainty from major economies’ shifting trade policies and heightened geopolitical tensions.”

MITI analysis notes that ongoing conflicts in the Middle East could disrupt global trade flows and increase cost pressures. It said Malaysia will continue to “assess developments, strengthen market diversification, expand entry into high‑growth markets, and help exporters adjust,” to boost the resilience of its foreign trade.

items.title_en: Far East Commercial Bank: US Rate‑Hike Expectations Cool, Dollar Generally Weakens
paras: ◆USD/JPY

美國聯邦準備理事會(FED)主席沃什雖對美國經濟韌性表示樂觀，且稱受益人工智能推動，並向其他領域擴展的投資熱潮，正引發短期需求衝擊，從而對通脹形成上行壓力，但拒絕透露關於今年剩餘時間的會議上可能採取的行動，使得美元承壓；此外，日本央行(BOJ)總裁植田和男表示，確保基礎通脹率穩定在BOJ 2%的通脹目標附近正變得越來越重要，且據路透公布一項調查顯示，隨著中東衝突推動能源價格上漲的影響正逐步傳導至家庭，日本9月核心消費者通脹率可能自12月以來首次超過BOJ 2%的目標，另外美國財政部次長Erin Browne指出，日本已不再面臨持續十餘年的通縮環境，其匯率水平與貨幣政策必須相應調整，並隨著日本投資人截至10月10日當週連續第四週淨賣出外國債券，延續了撤離海外債市的趨勢，提供日圓支撐，令美元兌日圓下降至157.67低點。

隨後據美國官方公布9月數據顯示，工業生產及製造業產出分別成長0.7%及0.3%，且衡量企業資源利用程度的產能利用率升至76.9%，另外進口及出口物價月率漲幅分別為1.1%及2.2%，皆超過市場預期，且進口物價同比上漲8.1%，漲幅為2022年7月以來最大，這進一步表明，隨著中東衝突持續，美國國內通脹壓力正在加劇，推動美元兌日圓走升至158.33高點。預估今日美元兌日圓阻力於158.10-30，支撐於157.30-50。
◆EUR/USD

澳洲疲軟的就業數據表現，促使投資人下調對澳洲央行(RBA)今年第五次加息的押注，拖累澳幣走勢，但相較於紐西蘭央行(RBNZ)首席經濟學家康韋在接受彭博新聞採訪時稱下一次利率調整一切皆有可能，隨著調期市場數據顯示，RBNZ在10月28日將利率上調25個基點概率為86%，為紐元提供支撐，而且國際貨幣基金(IMF)預計歐洲央行(ECB)於2026年至少加息25個基點，提振歐元兌美元觸及1.1269高點。
據歐盟統計局公布歐元區9月消費者物價調和指數(HICP)月率及年率分別上升0.6%及3.8%，符合預期，但8月未經季節性調整貿易數據意外錄得逆差161億歐元，且據IMF指出法國借貸成本短期內仍屬可控，但財政整頓壓力恐將加大，打擊歐元兌美元至1.1206低點。預估今日歐元兌美元支撐於1.1190-1.1210，阻力於1.1260-80。
◆GBP/USD

週五英國央行(BOE)總裁貝利於出席國際金融協會(IIF)時表示英國通脹率高於目標水平，但迄今為止，能源價格飆升似乎對英國物價廣泛影響有限，令英鎊兌美元盤整於1.3263低點；隨後美國FED主席沃什未對美國強勁的CPI及PPI數據置評，使得10月FED加息的概率也因沃什的言論而下降，相較於路透調查的多數經濟學家預測，BOE將於11月將指標利率上調至4.0%，這將是該行三年多來的首次加息，激勵英鎊兌美元漲至三週高點1.3371。預估今日英鎊兌美元支撐於1.3290-1.3310，阻力於1.3370-90。

paras_en: USD/JPY

Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell expressed optimism about the resilience of the U.S. economy and said that the investment boom spurred by artificial‑intelligence advances and its spill‑over into other sectors is creating short‑term demand pressure that could push inflation higher. He declined to reveal what actions might be taken at the remaining meetings this year, leaving the dollar under pressure. Meanwhile, Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda said it is becoming increasingly important to keep core‑inflation near the BOJ’s 2% target, and a Reuters poll shows that rising energy prices from the Middle‑East conflict are gradually passing through to households. Japan’s core CPI for September could exceed the BOJ’s 2% goal for the first time since December. U.S. Treasury Deputy Secretary Erin Browne added that Japan is no longer in a decade‑long deflationary environment, so its exchange‑rate level and monetary policy must adjust. Japanese investors have sold foreign bonds for the fourth consecutive week as of the week ending Oct. 10, continuing the pull‑out from overseas bond markets, which supports the yen and pushed USD/JPY down to a low of 157.67.

Subsequent U.S. official data for September showed industrial production up 0.7% and manufacturing output up 0.3%, while capacity utilization rose to 76.9%. Import and export prices rose 1.1% and 2.2% month‑over‑month, both above expectations, and import prices jumped 8.1% year‑over‑year – the biggest rise since July 2022. The figures indicate that, as the Middle‑East conflict persists, domestic inflation pressure in the United States is intensifying, driving the dollar up to a high of 158.33 against the yen. The market expects resistance for USD/JPY around 158.10‑30 and support around 157.30‑50.
EUR/USD

Weak Australian employment data led investors to downgrade bets on a fifth RBA rate hike this year, weighing on the Aussie dollar. By contrast, Reserve Bank of New Zealand chief economist Michael Baker told Bloomberg that any outcome is possible for the next rate move, and market data show an 86% probability that the RBNZ will raise rates by 25 basis points on Oct. 28, supporting the kiwi. The International Monetary Fund also projects that the European Central Bank will lift rates by at least 25 basis points in 2026, helping the euro climb to a high of 1.1269 against the dollar.

Euro‑area CPI data released by Eurostat showed the Harmonised Index of Consumer Prices rising 0.6% month‑over‑month and 3.8% year‑over‑year in September, in line with expectations. However, seasonally‑adjusted trade data for August unexpectedly posted a €16.1 billion deficit. The IMF noted that France’s short‑term borrowing costs remain manageable, but fiscal‑adjustment pressure could increase, pushing EUR/USD down to a low of 1.1206. The market expects support for the euro around 1.1190‑1.1210 and resistance around 1.1260‑1.1280.
GBP/USD

On Friday, Bank of England Governor Andrew Holmes told the International Finance Forum that UK inflation remains above target, but so far the surge in energy prices has had limited broad‑based impact on prices, leaving the pound flat at a low of 1.3263 against the dollar. Later, Fed Chair Jerome Powell did not comment on the strong U.S. CPI and PPI numbers, reducing the perceived probability of an October Fed hike. Most Reuters‑surveyed economists now expect the BOE to raise its policy rate to 4.0% in November – the first hike in more than three years – which could lift GBP/USD to a three‑week high of 1.3371. The market projects support for the pound around 1.3290‑1.3310 and resistance around 1.3370‑1.3390.

items.title: 台幣逼近32.5元還會貶？外銀看好強勁出口支撐 年底反攻31.5元
items.title_en: Taiwan Dollar Near 32.5 per Dollar – Will It Depreciate Further? Foreign Banks See Strong Export Support, Expect a Rebound to 31.5 by Year‑End
paras: 分析師表示，全球市場對人工智慧（AI）交易的疑慮引發新台幣走弱，卻掩蓋了台灣經濟的基本韌性；穩健的經濟基本面可望支撐新台幣在年底前回升。
儘管新台幣近期承受沉重壓力，華僑銀行與荷蘭國際集團（ING）仍預期，新台幣將分別回升至兌1美元31.60元與31.50元，較目前水準升值約2%。
這些預測的依據，是台灣強勁的經濟成長與經常帳順差。儘管市場對AI股高估值的疑慮持續推動資金外流，短期壓抑匯率，分析師預期，未來幾個月貿易基本面的支撐終將占上風。
三菱日聯銀行（MUFG）亞洲全球市場研究主管Lin Li表示：「創紀錄的貿易順差與AI相關出口，持續為新台幣提供基本支撐。但外資證券投資流出、對外投資，以及美元與新台幣之間龐大的利差，目前正創造美元需求，抵銷這些支撐。」
她預期，新台幣年底前將升至兌1美元31.8元，並在2027年6月底進一步升至30.9元。
出口與順差強勁 外資撤出台股形成拉鋸
受全球先進晶片需求空前強勁帶動，台灣經常帳順差在2025年底達到近700億美元的歷史新高，近幾個月則溫和收窄。同時，政府將全年經濟成長率預測上修至逾10%，台灣可望迎來2010年以來首次雙位數成長。
不過，這些基本面優勢正與外資撤離潮相互拉鋸。外資周四賣超台股新台幣3,026億元（約93億美元），創單日新高，推動新台幣逼近今年以來兌1美元約32.50元的低點。
雖然分析師不認為這個價位是央行必須捍衛的防線，但仍密切關注，視其為央行可接受匯率區間的重要參考。
ING大中華區首席經濟學家宋林表示：「央行將試圖讓新台幣維持相對區間震盪。我不認為存在必須守住的明確防線，但今年以來，31.5至32.5元似乎一直是央行可以接受的區間。」
道富銀行亞太區總體策略師Jiuk Choi認為，央行更可能著重降低匯率波動，而非鎖定特定價位。他表示：「話雖如此，我們認為美元兌新台幣32.4至32.5元是重要區間，因為這是2026年以來的高點。」
油價與利差添壓力 中期仍看升
除了科技業疑慮，台灣作為能源進口國，偏高的原油價格也為新台幣增添壓力。此外，美國10年期公債殖利率較台灣同天期公債高出約300個基點，具吸引力的利差持續支撐美元普遍走強，壓抑區域貨幣表現。
LGT私人銀行外匯與利率專家Trang Le表示：「短期逆風包括外資撤出台股，以及聯準會立場偏鷹帶動美元走強。」
她指出：「即便如此，強勁的出口動能、穩健的對外收支，以及AI驅動的半導體景氣循環，仍使新台幣中期走勢偏向升值。我們預期，匯率波動將是主軸，而非持續走弱。」
科技財報成下一個匯率關鍵
匯市交易員正關注主要半導體製造商的財報，策略師視其為牽動跨境股市資金流向與匯率波動的下一個關鍵因素。台積電周四公布優於預期的營收展望，卻未能完全平息市場對整體AI基礎建設擴張的疑慮。
道富銀行的Choi表示：「接下來公布的全球科技業財報，可能加劇新台幣波動，尤其市場對AI相關資本支出、獲利能力及中國競爭的敏感度已升高。」
他認為，AI交易疑慮仍可能讓新台幣短期進一步走弱，但預期年底前將回升至兌1美元31.80元。
他表示：「我們認為，新台幣是對沖美元走強的最佳貨幣之一，因為資本與經常帳資金流仍然強勁，而且新台幣也是新興市場中波動率最低的貨幣之一。」
paras_en: Analysts say that global concerns over artificial‑intelligence (AI) trading have weakened the New Taiwan dollar, but this masks the underlying resilience of Taiwan’s economy; a solid economic foundation is expected to support a rebound of the currency before year‑end.

Even though the New Taiwan dollar has been under heavy pressure recently, both OCBC and ING forecast that it will recover to about NT$31.60 per US$1 and NT$31.50 per US$1 respectively, roughly a 2% appreciation from current levels.

These forecasts are based on Taiwan’s strong economic growth and current‑account surplus. Although market worries about over‑valued AI stocks continue to drive capital outflows and suppress the exchange rate in the short term, analysts expect the trade fundamentals to ultimately prevail in the coming months.

Lin Li, head of Asian Global Markets Research at MUFG, said: “Record‑high trade surpluses and AI‑related exports continuously provide fundamental support for the New Taiwan dollar. Yet foreign‑security outflows, outbound investment and the huge interest‑rate differential between the dollar and the New Taiwan dollar are currently creating dollar demand that offsets those supports.”
She projects the New Taiwan dollar will rise to NT$31.8 per US$1 by year‑end and further to NT$30.9 by the end of June 2027.
Strong exports and surplus, foreign‑capital pull‑out creates a tug‑of‑war in Taiwan equities

Fueled by unprecedented demand for advanced chips worldwide, Taiwan’s current‑account surplus is set to hit a historic high of nearly US$70 billion by the end of 2025, though it has narrowed modestly in recent months. At the same time, the government has lifted its full‑year growth forecast to above 10%, positioning Taiwan for its first double‑digit expansion since 2010.

However, these fundamental strengths are being contested by a wave of foreign‑capital outflows. On Thursday foreign investors sold NT$3,026 billion (about US$9.3 billion) of Taiwan equities, a single‑day record, pushing the New Taiwan dollar toward this year’s low of roughly NT$32.50 per US$1.
While analysts do not view this level as a hard floor the central bank must defend, they are watching it closely as an important reference for the exchange‑rate band the bank may tolerate.

Song Lin, chief economist for Greater China at ING, said: “The central bank will try to keep the New Taiwan dollar within a relative range. I don’t see a clear floor that must be defended, but since the start of the year the NT$31.5‑NT$32.5 band has seemed acceptable to the central bank.”

Jiuk Choi, global‑strategy head for Asia‑Pacific at State Street, believes the central bank is more likely to focus on reducing volatility rather than anchoring a specific level. He added: “That said, we see NT$32.4‑NT$32.5 per US$1 as a key zone because it marks the high point reached in 2026.”
Oil prices and interest‑rate spreads add pressure; medium‑term outlook still upward

Beyond tech‑sector concerns, Taiwan’s status as an energy‑importing nation means high crude‑oil prices add further pressure on the New Taiwan dollar. In addition, the U.S. 10‑year Treasury yield is about 300 basis points higher than Taiwan’s comparable bond, and the attractive spread continues to underpin a broadly strong dollar, suppressing regional currencies.
Trang Le, FX and rates specialist at LGT Private Bank, said: “Short‑term headwinds include foreign‑capital outflows from Taiwan equities and a hawkish Fed stance that is bolstering the dollar.”

She noted: “Even so, strong export momentum, solid external balances and an AI‑driven semiconductor cycle still tilt the medium‑term New Taiwan dollar trend toward appreciation. We expect exchange‑rate volatility to be the main driver, not a continued weakening.”
Tech earnings become the next exchange‑rate catalyst

FX traders are watching earnings reports from major semiconductor manufacturers, which strategists see as the next key factor influencing cross‑border equity flows and currency moves. TSMC’s Thursday earnings outlook beat expectations, but did not fully allay market concerns about the broader AI‑infrastructure expansion.

State Street’s Choi said: “The upcoming global tech earnings season could amplify New Taiwan dollar volatility, especially as market sensitivity to AI‑related capex, profitability and competition from China has risen.”
He believes AI‑trading worries could still push the New Taiwan dollar lower in the short term, but expects a rebound to NT$31.80 per US$1 by year‑end.

He added: “We see the New Taiwan dollar as one of the best hedges against a strong dollar because capital and current‑account flows remain robust, and the New Taiwan dollar is also among the least volatile currencies in emerging markets.”

items.title: 美烏矛盾與法國騷亂推升美元！歐元兌多數G10貨幣走貶 今早兌美元一度大跌0.5%
items.title_en: US-Ukraine Tensions and French Unrest Boost the Dollar! Euro Falls Against Most G10 Currencies, Briefly Dropping 0.5% Against the Dollar This Morning
paras: 受美烏矛盾進一步升高及法國大規模抗議活動影響，市場對歐元信心受挫，歐元兌多數G10貨幣在今(19)日亞洲早盤交易時段走低。
周末期間，法國多個城市抗議活動演變為警方與示威者之間的衝突，爆發法國多年來最嚴重的街頭暴力事件，出現搶劫、地標建築遭縱火情況。歐洲多國接連發生示威活動，法國的抗議規模最大，比利時、義大利、葡萄牙也受到波及。與此同時，烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基周日(18日)指責川普試圖向基輔施壓，逼迫烏克蘭向俄羅斯投降。
歐元兌美元在今日早盤一度貶值0.5%，最低貶至 1.1183 美元，隨後部分收復跌幅，交投於 1.1212 美元附近。受歐元走弱拖累，東歐貨幣表現弱於其他新興市場貨幣，美元兌波蘭茲羅提升值0.5%，報3.9071；美元兌匈牙利福林走升0.5%，報324.88，美元兌保加利亞列弗亦升值0.5%，報1.7485。
澳洲聯邦銀行外匯策略師Carol Kong表示：「市場恐將持續為歐元計入風險溢價。歐元兌美元本周可能測試 1.1130支撐價位，尤其是在地緣緊張進一步推高美元的情況下。」
paras_en: Rising US‑Ukraine tensions and large‑scale protests in France have dented market confidence in the euro, causing the euro to fall against most G10 currencies during Asian early‑trade on the 19th.

Over the weekend, protests in several French cities escalated into clashes between police and demonstrators, sparking the most severe street violence France has seen in years, including robberies and arson of landmark buildings. Demonstrations spread across multiple European countries, with France seeing the largest protests, and Belgium, Italy and Portugal also affected. At the same time, Ukrainian President Zelensky on Sunday (the 18th) accused former U.S. President Trump of trying to pressure Kyiv into surrendering to Russia.

The euro‑dollar pair slipped as much as 0.5% in early trade today, hitting a low of 1.1183 USD before partially regaining ground and trading around 1.1212 USD. The euro’s weakness also weighed on Eastern European currencies, which underperformed other emerging‑market currencies: the dollar rose 0.5% against the Polish zloty to 3.9071, against the Hungarian forint to 324.88, and against the Bulgarian lev to 1.7485.

Carol Kong, FX strategist at Commonwealth Bank of Australia, said: “The market is likely to continue pricing a risk premium into the euro. The euro‑dollar pair could test the 1.1130 support level this week, especially if geopolitical tensions further lift the dollar.”

items.title: 阿拉伯半島周遭海域周末頻傳商船遇襲！伊朗警告：美若恢復攻擊  已有「新作戰計畫」
items.title_en: Commercial Ships Frequently Attacked Around the Arabian Peninsula Over the Weekend; Iran Warns of a New Operational Plan if the U.S. Resumes Attacks
paras: 伊朗最高國家安全委員會秘書雷札伊周日(18日)警告，已針對美國與以色列「任何新的冒險行徑」擬定回應方案，並稱伊朗武裝力量的反制將比先前「12天戰爭」與「40天戰爭」更具毀滅性，「新作戰計畫不會遵循他們熟悉的規則」。
雷札伊身分相當具分量，曾任革命衛隊總司令，現掌伊朗安全決策核心機構。這一表態正值中東海域風險上升，因根據英國海上貿易行動辦公室數據，沙烏地阿拉伯朱拜勒附近海域接連有油輪遭不明發射物及火箭彈襲擊，阿曼灣、荷姆茲海峽週邊亦傳船舶受襲，船員暫報安全。
華府則同步釋放矛盾訊號。川普上周受訪時表示，不打算對伊朗使用核武器，也不預見部署美軍地面部隊，但華府仍保留常規打擊選項。
伊朗外長阿拉格齊則回應，德黑蘭不會在壓力下放棄主權權利，但仍準備對話。
分析人士認為，伊朗意在以強硬威懾換取談判籌碼，商船遇襲與荷姆茲通航風險則持續牽動能源市場神經。
paras_en: Iran’s Supreme National Security Council secretary, Rezaei, warned on Sunday (the 18th) that a response plan has been drafted for any new adventurism by the United States and Israel, and said Iran’s armed forces would retaliate with a level of devastation greater than the previous “12‑day war” and “40‑day war,” noting that the new operational plan would not follow the rules they are accustomed to.

Rezaei’s statement carries weight; he is a former commander of the Revolutionary Guard and now heads Iran’s core security‑decision body. The remark comes as risks in Middle‑East waters rise, with UK Maritime Trade Operations data showing a series of attacks on tankers near Saudi Arabia’s Jabal al‑Dukhan, as well as incidents in the Oman Sea and the Strait of Hormuz where vessels were struck by unknown projectiles and rockets, though crews have so far reported being safe.

Washington simultaneously sent mixed signals. In an interview last week, President Trump said he does not intend to use nuclear weapons against Iran and does not foresee deploying U.S. ground troops, yet the administration still retains the option of conventional strikes.
Iranian Foreign Minister Amir‑Abdollahian responded that Tehran will not relinquish its sovereign rights under pressure, but remains ready for dialogue.

Analysts believe Iran is using a hard‑line deterrent to gain bargaining chips in negotiations, and the ongoing attacks on commercial vessels and the navigation risk in the Strait of Hormuz continue to nerve the energy markets.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元逾1個月來首見單週跌幅 升息預期降溫、AI疑慮持續
items.title_en: <New York Forex> US Dollar Records First Weekly Decline in Over a Month as Rate‑Hike Expectations Cool and AI Concerns Persist
paras: 美元周五(16日)走低，兌歐元與日元均創下逾1個月來首見單週貶值，反映市場對聯準會(Fed)升息的預期降溫，以及投資人對AI引發股市賣壓的疑慮持續存在。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.17%，報101.87，本週下跌約0.35%。
本週公布的消費者物價與生產者物價數據均高於預期，一度令市場感到不安。不過，聯準會官員的談話顯示，目前沒有急於進一步緊縮貨幣政策的必要，有助於穩定美國公債殖利率，也削弱了美元的支撐力道。
AI類股本週大幅下跌，壓力也蔓延至部分信用市場。由於投資人已大量押注AI供應鏈各個環節，如今開始擔心資料中心營運商可能無法及時實現獲利，進而償還債務。
StoneX全球市場研究主管Matt Weller表示，「我認為今天乃至本週最值得關注的現象，是美元與AI交易之間的緊密連動。通常科技股遭到拋售時，市場會預期美元因避險需求而走強。我們確實看到部分資金流向債券，但美元實際上卻在下跌。」
本週英鎊與瑞士法郎兌美元的升幅居前。瑞士法郎受到避險需求支撐，市場也預期，即使利率環境進一步走低，瑞士仍不太可能將政策利率降至目前零利率以下。
英鎊兌美元上漲0.31%，至1英鎊兌1.3314美元，本週累計上漲0.63%。
美元兌瑞士法郎則下跌0.25%，至0.8246瑞郎，本週累計下跌0.67%。瑞郎在過去兩個交易日累計升值逾1.4%。
芝商所（CME）FedWatch工具顯示，市場預估聯準會本月稍晚維持利率不變的機率為83%，高於一個月前的49%。
聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)週五出席在曼谷舉行的國際貨幣基金（IMF）與世界銀行年度會議時，並未透露未來利率決策的線索。他表示，自己不會「預先判斷」任何一次會議的決策。
紐約梅隆銀行宏觀經濟策略師John Velis表示，「我認為，目前聯準會決策委員會內部，尤其是理事們，尚未形成足夠共識支持10月升息。不過，12月是否升息仍是未解之題，從現在到那時還有許多事情可能發生。」
歐元區財政風險仍受關注
法國財政風險仍是市場關注的背景因素。10月初，法國債務風險溢價曾大幅攀升。
歐元兌美元上漲0.08%，至1歐元兌1.1227美元。歐元週四已上漲0.56%，創下兩個月來最大單日漲幅，全週上漲約0.23%。
投資人預期，美國總統川普將避免讓中東或烏克蘭局勢進一步升級，因為更大規模的衝突可能推升通膨，進而損害他在期中選舉前的政治支持度。
美元兌日元下跌0.08%，至158.11日元。日元終止連續四週貶值走勢，本週升值0.13%。此前，伊朗衝突支撐美元走強。
近期油價上漲推升美元，同時對歐元與日元等能源進口國貨幣造成壓力。
日本銀行（BOJ）總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)週五再次強調，潛在通膨率可能超越央行設定的2%目標，仍是需要留意的風險。

paras_en: The dollar fell on Friday (the 16th), with both the euro and the yen posting their first weekly depreciation in more than a month, reflecting a cooling of market expectations for further Fed rate hikes and lingering investor worries that AI is weighing on equity markets.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, slipped 0.17% to 101.87, down about 0.35% for the week.

Consumer price and producer price data released this week came in above expectations, briefly unsettling markets. However, comments from Fed officials indicated no urgent need for further monetary tightening, helping to stabilise US Treasury yields and weakening support for the dollar.

AI‑related stocks fell sharply this week, and the pressure spread to parts of the credit market. Investors, who have heavily bet on every link of the AI supply chain, are now worried that data‑center operators may not generate profits quickly enough to service their debt.

Matt Weller, head of global market research at StoneX, said, "I think the most noteworthy phenomenon today and this week is the tight link between the dollar and AI trading. Usually when tech stocks are sold off, the market expects the dollar to strengthen on safe‑haven demand. We did see some flows into bonds, but the dollar actually fell."

The pound and the Swiss franc posted the biggest gains against the dollar this week. The franc was supported by safe‑haven demand, and markets expect that even if rates fall further, Switzerland is unlikely to push its policy rate below the current zero‑percent level.
The pound rose 0.31% to $1.3314, up 0.63% for the week.
The dollar slipped 0.25% against the Swiss franc to 0.8246 CHF, down 0.67% for the week. The franc had appreciated more than 1.4% over the past two trading days.
CME’s FedWatch tool shows the market now assigns an 83% probability that the Fed will keep rates unchanged later this month, up from 49% a month ago.
Fed Chair Kevin Warsh attended the IMF and World Bank annual meetings in Bangkok on Friday and offered no clues about future rate decisions, saying he does not "pre‑judge" the outcome of any meeting.

John Velis, macro strategy strategist at BNY Mellon, said, "I think the Fed’s policy committee, especially the governors, have not yet reached sufficient consensus to support a rate hike in October. However, whether there will be a hike in December remains an open question, and many things could happen between now and then."
Euro‑area fiscal risks remain a focus.
Fiscal risk in France continues to be a background concern for markets, with French sovereign risk premiums spiking sharply in early October.
The euro rose 0.08% to $1.1227. It had gained 0.56% on Thursday, the biggest single‑day rise in two months, and is up about 0.23% for the week.

Investors expect that President Trump will try to avoid further escalation in the Middle East or Ukraine, as a larger conflict could push inflation higher and damage his political support ahead of the mid‑term elections.
The dollar fell 0.08% to ¥158.11, ending a four‑week streak of depreciation for the yen, which rose 0.13% this week. Previously, the Iran conflict had supported a stronger dollar.
Recent oil price gains have lifted the dollar while putting pressure on currencies of energy‑importing countries such as the euro and yen.
Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda reiterated on Friday that a potential inflation rate above the BOJ’s 2% target remains a risk to watch.

items.title: 〈台幣〉股匯不同調 續貶7.3分失守32.3元關卡
items.title_en: Taiwan Dollar Weakens While Stocks Hold, Falling 0.73 ¢ to Slip Below the 32.3 TWD Mark
paras: 在美元指數維持強勢、外資持續撤出亞洲市場影響下，新台幣兌美元今 (16) 日走弱，終場收在32.338元，貶值7.3分，續創近期波段低點，顯示國際資金仍偏向美元資產，相較於昨天的91億美元爆巨量，台北外匯經紀公司與元太外匯經紀公司合計總成交量為 46.12億美元。
儘管匯市承壓，台股表現相對有撐，加權指數終場收在47,111點，上漲141點，漲幅約0.3%，呈現匯弱股強格局。市場買盤主要聚焦 AI 伺服器、高階 PCB 及半導體供應鏈族群，在電子權值股支撐下，大盤成功守住漲勢。
從籌碼面來看，統計今日三大法人合計賣超約729億元，其中外資賣超高達494億元，已連續第8個交易日站在賣方；投信則持續扮演護盤角色，買超約132億元，寫下連6買；自營商賣超約367億元。
市場人士指出，本波新台幣轉弱主要受到美元升值效應帶動，近期美國經濟數據維持韌性，加上市場重新評估聯準會後續政策路徑，推升美元買盤，亞洲主要貨幣同步承壓，新台幣也不例外。資料顯示，10月以來新台幣已由31字頭一路走貶至32.3元以上水準。

paras_en: Under a strong US dollar index and continued foreign‑capital outflows from Asian markets, the New Taiwan dollar weakened against the US dollar today (Oct 16), closing at 32.338 TWD, down 0.73 ¢ and extending its recent low‑point swing, indicating that international funds remain biased toward dollar assets. In contrast to yesterday’s massive USD 91 billion turnover, Taipei’s foreign‑exchange brokers and Yuan‑Tai FX brokers together handled a total volume of USD 46.12 billion.

Despite pressure on the currency market, Taiwan’s equity market showed relative resilience, with the weighted index closing at 47,111 points, up 141 points or about 0.3%, reflecting a “weak currency, strong stocks” pattern. Buying interest centered on AI servers, high‑end PCBs and semiconductor supply‑chain groups, and the rally in heavyweight electronics stocks helped the market maintain its upward momentum.

From a flow perspective, the three major institutional investors sold a combined net NT$729 billion today, with foreign investors leading the sell‑side at NT$494 billion for the eighth consecutive trading day. Trust funds continued to play a stabilising role, net‑buying about NT$132 billion for the sixth straight session, while proprietary traders sold roughly NT$367 billion.

Market observers said the recent weakening of the Taiwan dollar is mainly driven by the dollar’s appreciation. Recent US economic data remain resilient and the market’s reassessment of the Fed’s policy path has boosted dollar demand, putting pressure on major Asian currencies, including the TWD. Data show that since October the Taiwan dollar has slid from the low‑31s to above the 32.3 TWD level.

Looking at capital flows, foreign investors have been adjusting their positions in Taiwan’s heavyweight and electronics stocks, becoming a key variable for both the FX and equity markets. However, trust‑fund buying is evident, and the fundamentals of AI‑related industries have not weakened, supporting the Taiwan stock market’s high‑level range‑bound pattern. Today’s market displayed a “bearish currency, bullish equity” stance: foreign outflows weakened the TWD, while strong demand for AI, high‑performance computing and advanced packaging kept domestic and long‑term buying interest in equities, allowing the stock market to stay relatively strong.
